authorization: Owner assigned SC-D007 to Codex on 2026-10-23; clarified queued Grok handoffs are not active assignments.
sourceEditorialReference: Owner accepted 2026-10-21 for personal use. Lessons from A1 through C2 follow the public Council of Europe CEFR global scale: A1 everyday expressions and personal information; A2 familiar routines; B1 connected experience and opinion; B2 detailed argument; C1 flexible professional discussion; C2 precise reformulation. Source: https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale . This is not a CEFR certificate and no outside reviewer was hired.
sourceRightsReference: Original SpeechCoachAI wording and reference audio, created for this app on 2026-10-21. The listening clips were synthesized in an American English voice. They are not copied from a textbook.
scope: All 13 topics in the adopted A1 outline, with exact INTRO-01 v3 reuse and 12 proposed v3 topic revisions. This finite volume is proposed for SC-T073 approval, not silently frozen.
